fixtures.env: Qingque E0 solo vs 3 Quantum-weak Elite (level 95, 240 Toughness), 3 cycles — Skill 120102 chains to a full quartet with hand-full discards, Hidden Hand (120104) Cherry on Top! enhanced basic, Ultimate 120103 hits all 3 enemies and refills the hand

Qingque E0 with Sushang (kitId sushang) vs the same Elite — Talent Celestial Jade (120104) draws a tile at every Sushang turn start, the chain fills a 4-tile hand and discards, an empty-hand turn tosses nothing

requirements.claim: Skill 'A Scoop of Moon' (characters.json 120102, Enhance) is cast as a skill action; AGENTS §qingque: it draws skill=2 tiles, spends 1 SP, and grants an Extra Turn so the chain repeats inside one turn.

Skill 120102 is pure Enhance: it deals no damage itself, so Qingque never lands an attackType 'skill' hit — damage only comes from Basic 120101 / Enhanced Basic 120108 / Ultimate 120103. (erudition.ts:585-603 — skill path only draws tiles and refreshes qingque_draw.)
Basic ATK 'Flower Pick' (characters.json 120101) hits the primary target as attackType basic (erudition.ts:641, label 'Flower Pick', 10 Toughness).
Ultimate 'A Quartet? Woo-hoo!' (characters.json 120103) fires as an ultimate action once Energy fills (energyMax 140).

Hidden Hand (120104) upgrades the next Basic into Enhanced Basic 'Cherry on Top!' (characters.json 120108, Blast) with main + adjacent hits (erudition.ts:624-625, labels 'Cherry on Top! (main)' / '(adj)').
Trace A0 'Tile Battle': the first Skill of the battle refunds +1 SP (AGENTS §qingque; erudition.ts:577-581 logs 'Tile Battle: +1 SP').

Skill 120102 grants no Energy — characters.json params of 120102 contain none (AGENTS §qingque audit removed an invented +30 Energy), so the first Energy event for Qingque in the battle is Basic 120101's +20.
Casting the Ultimate consumes the full Energy pool of 140 (energyMax = sp_need 140, AGENTS §qingque; ENERGY_LOSS reason 'ult_cost').
The Ultimate cast grants the generic castUlt +5 Energy refund after the cost is paid (AGENTS: '+5 Energy (из castUlt)'; observed post-cost ENERGY_GAIN n=5).

Skill stacks qingque_draw as dmgAll = (skill_a2 + 0.10) per stack up to the skill_a3 cap of 4 (AGENTS §qingque 'boost N/4 с реальным потолком 4'; erudition.ts:589-595) — a full chain ends at 0.38×4 = 1.52.
qingque_draw (A Scoop of Moon DMG boost) lasts exactly 1 turn — it expires at the end of the casting turn (BUFF_EXPIRED qingque_draw each turn).

Hidden Hand grants atkPct equal to the Talent trace value at level 10 — 0.72 (AGENTS §qingque: qingque_hidden_hand atkPct = трейс таланта; erudition.ts:537 mult('qingque','talent')) — lasting Infinity until the enhanced basic consumes it.
Cherry on Top! grants A0 'Winning Hand' +10% SPD for 1 turn (AGENTS §qingque; erudition.ts:636 spdPct 0.1, turns 1).
Ultimate 120103 is AoEAttack: one hit per living enemy — exactly 3 hits against the 3-Elite fixture (erudition.ts:560 sim.hitAoe label 'A Quartet? Woo-hoo!').
Turn order inside the chain: the Skill action resolves first, then the tossed Basic 'Flower Pick' hit (skill chain ends in a basic — erudition.ts decide path).
The qingque_draw DMG-boost buff is applied during the Skill, before the 'Flower Pick' hit it boosts.
Hidden Hand (120104) is entered at the start of the holding turn, before the enhanced 'Cherry on Top!' hit fires (erudition.ts:527-540 onTurnStart, then perform basic).
Ultimate Energy is consumed first (ENERGY_LOSS 140, reason ult_cost), then the +5 refund arrives — cost resolves before refund.
The skill chain ramps boost 1/4 → 4/4 in order inside one turn (erudition.ts:603 'boost ${st}/${cap}', cap = mult('qingque','skill_a3') = 4).

Talent Celestial Jade (characters.json 120104, 'When an ally's turn starts... draws 1 tile') fires at Sushang's turn start — every other ally's turn draws a tile (erudition.ts:515 'EVERY other ally's turn start').
Hand capacity is 4 (HAND_MAX, AGENTS §qingque): a draw while the hand is full discards the drawn tile (erudition.ts:478 drawOne discard branch — 'discards a … (A Scoop of Moon, hand full)').

of.log: discards a .+ tile \(A Scoop of Moon, hand full\)

requirements.claim: An empty-hand Enhanced Basic tosses nothing and still lands Cherry on Top! (erudition.ts:617 'has an empty hand — nothing to toss'; AGENTS §qingque: empty hand → Basic without a toss).
Ultimate 120103 'obtains 4 jade tiles of the same suit' — the whole hand is replaced by 4 identical tiles (characters.json 120103 desc; erudition.ts:566 logs 'A Quartet? Woo-hoo! — 4 <suit> tiles').
